node.title: PROVED (autonomous #47): the n^2 -> n^3 sufficiency rewiring
node.statement: Both hard consumers (U1's primitive star/PTE column, B's exit 3) can consume the row-wise fully-stripped split-pair count R_PTE(row) DIRECTLY as a single compiler column (one shared residue_column_id — they are the SAME family by star-PTE + X-10 + B-WRITEUP, not two), charged like the already-accepted quotient/dihedral staircase columns. The compiler's exact integer room (QA.22 + QA.25 certificates) satisfies n^3 <= B* - repaired_budget_total at every row (31 checks; even two such columns fit). CONSEQUENCE: the terminal target drops from R_PTE <= n^2 to R_PTE <= n^3. HONEST SCOPE (verified here): W4 proves SUFFICIENCY only — the estimate R_PTE <= n^3 itself remains open; and the charging is legitimate because R_PTE is the same shape of structured row-count the compiler already prices.
node.notes: Autonomous proof, verified as sound bookkeeping. NOT a closure — it lowers the bar by a full power of n.
